worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.summary: Raise a grassy pillar that damages and entangles enemies, leaving a Grass Pledge seal. Combine with a nearby allied Fire Pledge to create a burning sea of fire, or with Water Pledge to create a trapping, slowing swamp. Combining consumes the participating seal.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.descriptio: The pillar bursts up at the chosen point, dealing about %1$s special damage to each of up to %2$s enemies inside.

The column is %1$s blocks in radius and %2$s blocks tall (a closer-bonded user grows it taller), rising from the real ground below the point and stopping at the contact face when it meets a block above; anyone caught is pinned by roots for %3$s - unable to move but still able to act - and carries a %4$s slow (movement speed about 30%% lower). Roots wrap only the feet of those actually pinned; a refused control drops a few leaves instead.
Leaves a Grass Pledge seal at the impact point, %1$s blocks wide in radius for %2$s. Other Pledge moves can combine with it.

If an allied, not-yet-combined fire or water pledge scar lies within %1$s blocks with an unobstructed path to the point, the two vows resonate: the strike's power is x%2$s, the participating scar is consumed, and the same scar widens on the spot into a combined field whose radius is about %3$s times the scar's - a sea of fire (grass + fire) or a wetland (grass + water). When a combined field already lies near the point, no old scar is reused to amplify again.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.entangle.o: Entangling vow: root duration x1.5, scar resonance window x0.8, combined-field radius x1.1 and cooldown +10, at the cost of pillar power x0.94.
Lush vow: pillar power x1.06, scar resonance window x1.2, combined-field radius x0.95 and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.timing: Cast range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.use.0: Raise a grass pillar on distant ground and entangle
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.use.1: Mark ground with a short scar that can resonate
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.use.2: Combine with a fire or water pledge into a sea of fire or a wetland
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.preference: On (entangling vow): root duration ×1.5, scar resonance window ×0.8, cooldown +10 — locks one target down. Off (lush vow): power ×1.06, scar resonance window ×1.2, shorter cooldown — hits harder and leaves a longer window for another pledge to resonate.
The companion only raises a grass pillar while the threat is within this distance; beyond it, it closes in first.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar gains another step with level (about %2$s).
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.descriptio: A sea of fire keeps non-allies inside burning: while burned they lose about a sixteenth of their maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1) and deal half physical damage. A wetland roots those who step in for about 1.5 seconds and keeps them heavily slowed (movement speed about 45% lower); only enemies actually touching the ground are rooted, and a jumping foe or a refused control attempt keeps only the slow and is not re-rooted. The combined field lives until its own time ends and shows its real boundary.
